As of quarter ended March 31, 2026; the total number of outstanding Employee Stock Options (ESOPs) reported were 14,47,911 Options. During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC) of the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on May 07, 2026, approved the forfeiture of 32,000 Options, that were earlier granted on June 07, 2025, under the Agro Tech Foods Limited Employees Stock Option Plan, 2024 and on June 07, 2026, by resolution passed through circulation, approved the grant of 1,30,367 Options. Subsequently, the total number of outstanding ESOPs for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, were 15,46,278 options.
During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Promoters, Cag-Tech (Mauritius) Limited acquired addtional 18,81,073 equity shares resulting in their aggregate total shareholding enhancing to 1,65,47,595 equity shares. Subsequent to the acquisition, the Promoter encumbered these additional 18,81,073 equity shares by way of "Non-Disposal Undertaking", as a result, the 100% shareholding of the Promoter as stated in the shareholding pattern is subject to encumbrance.
The Significant Beneficial Owners (SBO's) mentioned in the SHP for Quarter ended June 30, 2026, are the Senior Management Officials of the Registered Owner i.e. CAG- Tech (Mauritius) Limited. Since the Registered Owner holds 43.90% shareholding in the Company; the same percentage holding is attributed to each SBO, who collectively account for the 43.90% shareholding of the Company.
